policy: A waiver is valid only with status=approved, an approver distinct from the requester, and an unexpired expiry. The exit gate counts proposed waivers as not-PASS.

waivers.reason: No pinned wasmCloud/NATS/wadm lattice, secret backend or monitoring stack is available to this repository; production adapter fails closed.
waivers.remediation: Provision the pinned lattice (SUPPORT_MATRIX.json) in an ephemeral CI environment and implement WasmCloudBackend + integration suite.

waivers.reason: No independent human reviewer/approver has signed the ADR, MASTER.md, compatibility review or exit gate. The builder may not approve its own evidence.
waivers.remediation: Named approvers record sign-off in REVIEWS.json and sign release/EXIT_GATE.json.

waivers.reason: Owner, team, pager, escalation contacts, support hours and patch SLAs are owner decisions.
waivers.remediation: Owner fills OWNERSHIP.json and approves SUPPORT_POLICY.md.

waivers.reason: Project licence not chosen; cannot assert an SPDX id on the owner's behalf.
waivers.remediation: Owner selects a licence; add LICENSE and SPDX to pyproject.

waivers.reason: No vulnerability feed or attestation signing key available offline; SBOM and config provenance are unsigned.
waivers.remediation: Wire a signing key (release signer) and an advisory feed into CI.

waivers.reason: CI defined and run locally only; no hosted runner, no CPU/OS matrix.
waivers.remediation: Push to a hosted CI with the declared matrix.

waivers.reason: No TPM/TEE attestation hardware and no power/thermal instrumentation.
waivers.remediation: Run on target edge hardware with attestation and power meters.

waivers.reason: Benchmarks are in-process on a cloud container, not target hardware; no soak/fleet.
waivers.remediation: Run tools/bench.py and a 24 h soak on reference hardware; record baselines.
Schedule and record rollout, restore and incident drills in REVIEWS.json.
